item.title: Self-Hosted Container Image Lazy Pulling: Stargz Snapshotter vs Nydus vs SOCI Snapshotter
item.description: Container image pulling is one of the most time-consuming steps in container deployment workflows. When a node needs to run a pod, it must first download the entire container image from a registry — every layer, every byte — before the container can start. For large images (multi-gigabyte database or ML images), this cold-start latency can range from tens of seconds to several minutes, severely impacting deployment velocity and autoscaling responsiveness.
